scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm start --prefix backend
scripts.db:init: sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P "YourStrongPassword123" -i backend/database.sql && sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P "YourStrongPassword123" -i backend/database_procedures.sql
scripts.db:init:mrkark: sqlcmd -S localhost -U mrkark -P mrkark9000 -i backend/database.sql && sqlcmd -S localhost -U mrkark -P mrkark9000 -i backend/database_procedures.sql
